owned_process_rows.cmd:
/usr/bin/bash -c exec 9>&0 8>&1 0</dev/null
read -r _prime_agent_gate <&9 || exit 127
{
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m governor architecture
} 8>&- 9>&-
__prime_status=$?
\set +x
'/bin/printf' '\036prime-agent-complete:%s%s\037' 'b2d8d45898cae8a6e3fd3ef06f9a5a4f' '2a03ea5adec4d513a0757f71ee30e349' >&8 || exit "$__prime_status"
'/bin/printf' '%s\n' "$__prime_status" >&9
exec 8>&- 9>&-
wait
exit "$__prime_status"
